protocol: Project-owned joint sparse target-matrix screen. Numeric continuous and binary labels are standardized per task and optimized together by masked MSE on full molecule batches. Architecture and learning-rate envelope follow the useful Jeremy clues, but task count and task definitions are selected from the owned challenge-disjoint corpus. Evaluation is target-specific raw600 LightGBM five-fold OOF; Jeremy and the prior owned task-sampler are frozen controls.
